content:
Adds a scanner to the scanner group. You can use the GET /scanner-groups/{group_id}/scanners
endpoint to verify that the scanner has been added to the specified scanner group.
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
integer <int32>
The ID of the scanner group.
integer <int32>
The ID of the scanner to add to the scanner group.
